name: io.github.nyssance/tauri-hasgard
title: Tauri Hasgard
description: Inspect and drive a running Tauri app's native webviews: snapshot, click, type, screenshot.

environmentVariables.name: TAURI_HASGARD_SOCKET
environmentVariables.description: Endpoint of the application to drive. Unset, the running application is discovered.

environmentVariables.name: TAURI_HASGARD_WINDOW
environmentVariables.description: Window label used by tool calls that name none.

environmentVariables.name: TAURI_HASGARD_MCP_ENABLE_DANGEROUS_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose the eval, ipc and drop tools, which run code or commands in the app.
